latest.headline: MU bounces to $733 pre-market after 7.6% drop; Nvidia reports tonight
latest.tldr: MU closed Monday at $719.02 (−7.62%) after a new US AI-chip export rule and a DRAM antitrust ruling, last printed $733.39 (+2.00%) at 6:52 ET, and I expect an open flat to about 4% higher, though that print is stale and Nvidia reports after the close.
